Swim up to your Speed while supporting up to two adjacent companions. This movement costs 1 per square and does not provoke.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and every willing ally initially within 3 squares.
Type
Magic / Movement / Defense

Move up to 3 squares without provoking. Each willing ally initially within 3 squares may then move up to 3 squares toward your new position without provoking. You and each ally that moves gain 1 Boon to the next defense before the end of your next turn.
